summary: Path intersection checks compute their coordinate tolerances with a loop instead of building temporary arrays for every candidate pair. Validation of a 2,000-part job drops from about 1,250 ms to 1,100 ms, and intersection-heavy drawings validate about 25% faster. The path-planning growth checks now time the fastest of five runs, so a garbage-collection pause or busy runner no longer fails them.
warning: No breaking change for installed posts, machine packages, saved revisions, CAD files or controller output. Tolerances are numerically identical, including NaN propagation, so diagnostics and derived documents are unchanged.

checklist.schema: No UPID, portable UPID, post, machine package, execution plan, saved revision, CAD, storage or journal schema change. Post engine API remains 1; saved-job engine remains 3.

changes: Checking a drawing for crossings and overlaps is faster on large jobs and drawings with many intersecting paths.
